en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi‑story building labeled "GRAND HOTEL DES ALPES" along a tree‑lined promenade. Well‑dressed men and women in early 20th‑century clothing stand and sit outside under tall conifer trees, some beneath parasols and a tented area. On the façade near the entrance there is signage for postal/telegraph services. Printed text at the upper right provides the location and altitude.
